name: Furnace
description: The town's headquarters and the first building unlocked. Its level caps the max level of every other building, contributes power, and keeps survivors warm through day/night cycles and snowstorms.

name: Embassy
description: An Alliance building that stores reinforcements sent by Alliance members and determines how much construction, research, and healing assistance you can receive. Upgrading it is typically required before the Furnace can advance to the next level.

name: Research Center
description: Where players research new technologies across three tabs (Growth, Economy, and Battle) to strengthen their town. Caps out at Level 30 with no Fire Crystal tier.

name: Command Center
description: Increases the total troops in a Rally you start and the troops in your own marches, alongside contributing power. Pairs with the Regimental Expansion technology for further march capacity.

name: Infantry Camp
description: Trains and upgrades Infantry troops. Increases training capacity and training speed, and unlocks higher troop tiers at certain thresholds, including the ability to promote lower-tier troops once Tier 5 is reached.

name: Marksman Camp
description: Trains and upgrades Marksmen. Increases training capacity and training speed, and unlocks higher troop tiers at certain thresholds, including the ability to promote lower-tier troops once Tier 5 is reached.

name: Lancer Camp
description: Trains and upgrades Lancers. Increases training capacity and training speed, and unlocks higher troop tiers at certain thresholds, including the ability to promote lower-tier troops once Tier 5 is reached.
